wave_state.completion_note: No unit has been set to COMPLETED. reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.found_by: po03-worker-a2 (gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh), defect 7; independently reproduced by the coordinator
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: The generic event subcommand enforced actor authority only inside cmd_complete. A worker-actor appended COMPLETED with a fabricated result_commit_id, the ledger projection accepted it as COMPLETED, and scan_recovery reported zero false completions because it tested only for a missing commit id and never for an unverifiable one.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.why_it_matters: This is the exact failure the commission exists to prevent. The control plane was built to make producer self-certification impossible and this path restored it.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.reproduction: python3 -I workstreams/po03/tools/control_plane.py event a3-u05 COMPLETED --actor po03-worker-a3 --provider-state COMPLETED --fence-token 1 --payload '{"result_commit_id":"totally-made-up"}' then projecting the unit and running the scanner.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.reproduction_residue: None. The probe ran against a ledger backup and the ledger was restored; chain verified valid afterwards.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: append_event performs an unlocked read-verify-append, so concurrent appends assign duplicate sequence numbers and break the hash chain. Measured 200 of 200 concurrent interleavings violating exactly-once custody or chain integrity.

Ingestion rejects a fence token lower than the current one but accepts an arbitrary higher one the coordinator never issued, so a worker can escalate its own ownership. Measured 10 of 10 unissued higher fences accepted.
A result_commit_id is accepted as durable for being a non-empty string, without resolving it against any remote. Measured 10 of 10 nonexistent remote commit locators accepted.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.found_by: coordinator, on live subordinate data during ingestion
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: The ingestion driver materialises a subordinate branch at HEAD rather than at the commit each result declares, so it was not reading back by immutable SHA. Unit a2-u01 was rejected for a fault_lab.py hash mismatch caused solely by a later commit on the same branch, not by any dishonesty.

fixtures_for_remediation.cause: declared commit correct; branch advanced; rejected at HEAD
declared commit correct; producer later fixed an unrelated false-red test in the same file; rejected at HEAD

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.escalation_reason: Escalated from HIGH. This defect has now falsely rejected honest work from two different cohorts in two different families. A verification step that rejects correct results is worse than no verification, because it destroys trust in the one control that distinguishes a real result from a claimed one.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.remediation_note: a11-u05 now has two real fixtures rather than one.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.found_by: po03-worker-a6 (gpt-5.6-luna-high), five locator discrepancies in its independent read-back audit
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: make_result.py stamps the commit that exists at emission time, but the result record is committed afterwards, so a result declares a commit that does not contain the result record itself.

Rejecting a corrupt or missing artifact raises but records nothing, so the rejection is invisible to recovery and committed artifacts are never re-hashed. Measured 20 of 20 rejections leaving no recovery state.

The recovery scanner detects but never remediates. No re-lease, retry, rerun, resume or result-slot reconciliation exists, so the commission's requirement of automatic resume or rerun of uncommitted tasks from immutable input is unmet. Measured 0 of 7 in-flight units resuming.

A fresh clone cannot discover subordinate result branches, so total runtime loss loses committed results in practice even though the bytes exist on the remote. Measured 0 of 10 committed results recovered from fresh clones.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.found_by: coordinator's own custody test suite, before any subordinate result arrived
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: Allowlist normalisation used lstrip('./'), wrongly rejecting .github/workflows/po03-*.yml and wrongly accepting a leading traversal such as './../packs/x'.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.found_by: coordinator's recovery scanner, on live subordinate results
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: ingest_result appended PARENT_INGESTED unconditionally, so reading an honestly failed result promoted the unit into a committed state. Eleven a2 units were reported as false completions.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.ledger_treatment: The eleven erroneous rows are retained as evidence and superseded by corrective events naming the defect and the true reported state. No row was rewritten or deleted.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: The seeded contract workflow triggered on push only for po03/** branches, so it never fired on the cursor/po03-*-ed20 branches the work is executed on.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.found_by: po03-worker-a1 (claude-opus-5-thinking-high), FIND-A1-02; reproduced by the coordinator
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: A pure per-row hash chain cannot detect tail truncation or suffix rewrite with recomputed digests. verify_chain reports a clean chain after rows are removed from the end.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.reproduction: Appended five rows, truncated to two, ran verify_chain: zero errors reported.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.why_it_matters: The ledger's tamper detection is blind to precisely the attack that hides evidence. Every custody claim in this commission rests on the ledger being tamper-evident.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.compounding_self_indictment: The coordinator's own test test_truncation_is_detected_by_projection_gap asserts that verify_chain returns no errors after truncation, while its name claims detection. The gate encoded the blind spot as acceptable, which is a false green inside the acceptance mechanism itself.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.found_by: po03-worker-a1, FIND-A1-01; reproduced by the coordinator
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: HEARTBEAT is not an admissible event kind and project_units has no case for it, so lease renewal cannot be recorded and a healthy renewing worker is reported as an expired lease.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.why_it_matters: Cannot cause false completion, since fencing still refuses an evicted holder, but it can evict a live worker and inflate recovery counts, which corrupts the operating metrics.

reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.defect: make_result derives attempt.checkpoint_seq from the artifact count and takes lease_id and fence_token from CLI defaults rather than from the ledger, so the attempt block is decorative and unusable as recovery evidence.

Verifying artifacts only at the commit a result declares admits a false green: a result can attest to bytes a later commit superseded, stay VALID, and read back byte-identically while describing an ancestor.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.significance: This is the exact inverse of DEF-05, where reading only at branch tip falsely rejected honest work. Neither check alone is sufficient; ingestion needs both, verifying at the declared commit and flagging attestations the tip has superseded.
reproduced_defects_in_the_coordinator_co.self_reported_instance: a1-u01 attested 100% tamper detection for a ledger.py that had since gained set_fault_hook. a1 found this by auditing its own documents, re-ran the campaign on current bytes and re-emitted a1-u01 and a1-u05.

findings_routed_to_other_cohorts.significance: The reviewer's mutation harness fired, so the review is demonstrably not ceremonial.

compounding_loop_evidence.claim: The operating loop ran as an executable loop, not as a report.
compounding_loop_evidence.sequence: operate (control plane built and 83 units dispatched) → observe (a2 and a6 returned) → measure (a2's matrix: 29 false completions, 200 duplicate effects, 0 of 23 committed results recoverable) → challenge (a6 rejected 30 of 30 and found a false green) → reproduce (coordinator independently reproduced the two most severe defects) → change the live mechanism (two defects already fixed with recurrence tests; nine registered as remediation units with frozen acceptance) → independently test (a10 is auditing the same control plane from a different model family) → next generation.
compounding_loop_evidence.cross_family_effect: Every one of the nine defects entering remediation was found by a model family other than the one that wrote the code under test, or by a test the author wrote against their own work. Heterogeneous independent cognition produced findings that same-family review would have been unlikely to surface.
compounding_loop_evidence.honesty_note: Cohort a2 falsified ten of its own twelve hypotheses and returned FAILED for ten units. That is the correct and most valuable outcome available to it, and it is recorded as such rather than softened.

outcome_basis: Recovery acceptance currently FAILS on cohort a2's evidence, and the coordinator has withheld every completion until the remediation cohort closes the actor-authority and commit-verification defects. Reporting PASS at this checkpoint would itself be the false completion this commission forbids.

a1_positive_confirmation.result: Driven over all fifteen Obzio states, the coordinator's cmd_complete refused completion from all thirteen states other than PARENT_INGESTED.
a1_positive_confirmation.significance: An independent cohort exhaustively confirmed the one invariant the commission cares about most, by search rather than by reading the code.
